machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE**: The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has 3 panels, titles exactly as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE**: New dashboard `fwgr54-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved (alert "Dashboard saved" shown). It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr54-n1 Availability` whose data source is **TestData** (plugin `grafana-testdata`, the default data source), using the default Random Walk query. Verified present after a full page reload.

**Objective 3 — DONE**: The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr54-n1 Notes` whose rendered content is `Notes for run fwgr54-n1` (includes the runid). Saved and verified after reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE**: Dashboard tag is `bench` (verified in Settings → General Tags field after reload: tag chip "bench" with its "Remove \"bench\" tag" button). Time range set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted by ticking the save-dialog checkbox labeled exactly **"Update default time range"** (sub-text "Will make current time range the new default") — after ticking, the dialog showed "Changes 1" and Save became enabled. After reloading the bare URL, the time picker reads "Time range selected: Last 6 hours" and the URL resolves to `?from=now-6h&to=now`, proving persistence rather than just the session's range.

**Objective 5 — DONE**: Auto-refresh interval set to **1m** via the top-bar refresh picker (menu offered Off/Auto/5s/10s/30s/1m/5m/15m/30m/1h/2h/1d). Persisted by ticking the save-dialog checkbox labeled **"Update default refresh value"** (sub-text "Will make the current refresh the new default"), which registered "Changes 1" and enabled Save; "Dashboard saved" alert shown. After reload the refresh indicator reads `1m` (aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE**: URL read from the browser's address bar on a fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfyj3tph53400a/fwgr54-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `dfyj3tph53400a`. The URL params themselves confirm the persisted 6h range and 1m refresh.

Final state verified on reload: breadcrumb "fwgr54-n1 Bench Dashboard", panels `fwgr54-n1 Notes` (Text) and `fwgr54-n1 Availability` (Stat), time range "Last 6 hours", refresh "1m", tag "bench".
